examples.en: Workers dug a deep trench along the road to lay water pipes.
examples.zh: 工人沿著馬路挖了一條深溝來鋪設水管。

examples.en: The Mariana Trench is the deepest part of the ocean.
examples.zh: 馬里亞納海溝是海洋中最深的地方。

examples.en: Rainwater collected in the trench beside the field.
examples.zh: 雨水積在田邊的水溝裡。

examples.en: Signs warn people not to trespass on the private farm.
examples.zh: 告示牌警告大家不得擅自闖入這座私人農場。

examples.en: The boys trespassed on the school roof to take photos.
examples.zh: 那些男孩擅自闖進學校屋頂拍照。

examples.en: It is illegal to trespass on railway tracks near the station.
examples.zh: 擅自闖入車站附近的鐵軌是違法的。

examples.en: The workers took their case to an employment tribunal.
examples.zh: 工人們把案子提交到勞資仲裁庭。

examples.en: A special tribunal will review the complaint next week.
examples.zh: 一個特別審裁會將在下週審查這項申訴。

examples.en: The tribunal ruled that the company had broken the contract.
examples.zh: 法庭裁定該公司違反了合約。

senses.zh: 三人組；三重奏；三件一組

examples.en: The trio performed a short piece at the school concert.
examples.zh: 這個三重奏在學校音樂會上演奏了一首短曲。

examples.en: The trio of friends traveled around Taiwan by train last summer.
examples.zh: 這三人組好友去年夏天搭火車環島旅行。

examples.en: She bought a trio of small plants for her balcony.
examples.zh: 她為自己的陽台買了三盆小植物。

senses.zh: 得勝的；得意洋洋的；凱旋的

examples.en: The triumphant team waved to the cheering crowd.
examples.zh: 得勝的球隊向歡呼的群眾揮手。

examples.en: She gave a triumphant smile when she saw her test score.
examples.zh: 她看到考試成績時露出得意洋洋的微笑。

examples.en: The students returned home triumphant after winning the contest.
examples.zh: 學生們贏得比賽後凱旋歸來。

senses.zh: 手推車；購物推車；行李推車

examples.en: She pushed the trolley down the aisle of the supermarket.
examples.zh: 她推著購物推車走過超市的走道。

examples.en: The flight attendant brought a trolley full of drinks.
examples.zh: 空服員推來一輛裝滿飲料的推車。

examples.en: Please return your luggage trolley to the stand after use.
examples.zh: 使用完畢後，請將行李推車歸還到停放處。

examples.en: The pony began to trot across the green field.
examples.zh: 小馬開始在綠色的田野上小跑。

examples.en: My little brother trotted down the stairs to open the door.
examples.zh: 我弟弟小跑下樓去開門。

examples.en: We trotted to the bus stop so we would not miss the bus.
examples.zh: 我們快步跑到公車站，才不會錯過公車。

examples.en: The horse slowed to a trot near the barn.
examples.zh: 馬在穀倉附近放慢成小跑。

examples.en: The children set off at a trot toward the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子們小跑著朝遊樂場出發。

examples.en: She went for a short trot around the park before breakfast.
examples.zh: 她在早餐前繞著公園小跑了一小段。

examples.en: The teacher called the parents of the truant.
examples.zh: 老師打電話給那位逃學學生的家長。

examples.en: A truant was found playing games at the arcade.
examples.zh: 有個逃學的學生被發現在遊樂場玩遊戲。

examples.en: Several truants were brought back to school by their parents.
examples.zh: 好幾個逃學的學生被家長帶回了學校。

examples.en: The two countries agreed to a truce during the holiday.
examples.zh: 兩國同意在假期期間休戰。

examples.en: My sister and I called a truce and shared the last cookie.
examples.zh: 我和姊姊決定休戰，一起分享最後一塊餅乾。

examples.en: Leaders hope the truce will lead to lasting peace.
examples.zh: 領袖們希望這次停火能帶來長久的和平。

examples.en: This is truly the best pizza I have ever eaten.
examples.zh: 這真的是我吃過最好吃的披薩。

examples.en: We are truly grateful for your help with the project.
examples.zh: 我們由衷感謝你對這個專案的協助。

examples.en: Is he truly interested in joining the science club?
examples.zh: 他真的有興趣加入科學社嗎？

examples.en: Tuberculosis is a serious disease that mainly affects the lungs.
examples.zh: 結核病是一種主要影響肺部的嚴重疾病。

examples.en: Doctors can treat tuberculosis with medicine taken for several months.
examples.zh: 醫生可以用需服用數個月的藥物來治療肺結核。

examples.en: Many countries ran campaigns to reduce tuberculosis a century ago.
examples.zh: 許多國家在一百年前推動活動，以減少結核病。

examples.en: Our class won the tug-of-war on sports day.
examples.zh: 我們班在運動會上贏得了拔河比賽。

examples.en: The two dogs played tug-of-war with an old rope.
examples.zh: 兩隻狗用一條舊繩子玩拔河。

examples.en: There is a tug-of-war between the two departments over the budget.
examples.zh: 兩個部門為了預算展開拉鋸戰。

examples.en: The wind turbine on the hill provides power to the village.
examples.zh: 山丘上的風力渦輪機為村子供電。

examples.en: Engineers repaired the steam turbine at the power plant.
examples.zh: 工程師修理了發電廠的蒸汽渦輪機。

examples.en: Water flows through the turbine to produce electricity.
examples.zh: 水流過渦輪機以產生電力。

senses.zh: 動盪的；湍急的；氣流不穩的

examples.en: The plane shook because of turbulent air over the mountains.
examples.zh: 由於山區上空氣流不穩，飛機搖晃了起來。

examples.en: The country went through a turbulent period in the 1980s.
examples.zh: 這個國家在一九八〇年代經歷了一段動盪的時期。

examples.en: Small boats should avoid the turbulent river after heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，小船應避開湍急的河流。

senses.zh: 營業額；人員流動率；餡餅

examples.en: The shop's annual turnover rose by ten percent.
examples.zh: 這家店的年營業額成長了百分之十。

examples.en: High staff turnover makes it hard to train new workers.
examples.zh: 員工流動率高，讓培訓新人變得很困難。

examples.en: She bought an apple turnover from the bakery.
examples.zh: 她在麵包店買了一個蘋果餡餅。

examples.en: Two-thirds of the students walk to school.
examples.zh: 三分之二的學生走路上學。

examples.en: I have already read two-thirds of this novel.
examples.zh: 我已經讀完這本小說的三分之二了。

examples.en: Two-thirds of the pizza was gone in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 披薩在十分鐘內就被吃掉了三分之二。

examples.en: Typically, the library opens at nine in the morning.
examples.zh: 圖書館通常早上九點開門。

examples.en: Teenagers typically need about eight hours of sleep.
examples.zh: 青少年一般需要約八小時的睡眠。

examples.en: The tour typically includes lunch at a local restaurant.
examples.zh: 這趟行程通常包含在當地餐廳用午餐。

examples.en: The people hoped to live free from tyranny.
examples.zh: 人民希望能生活在沒有暴政的環境中。

examples.en: The novel describes a society under the tyranny of a single ruler.
examples.zh: 這本小說描寫一個處於單一統治者暴政之下的社會。

examples.en: Some students feel the strict rules are a kind of tyranny.
examples.zh: 有些學生覺得這些嚴格的規定是一種專制。

senses.zh: 暴君；專制君主；霸道的人

examples.en: In the story, the king slowly turned into a tyrant.
examples.zh: 在故事中，這位國王漸漸變成了暴君。

examples.en: Many people in the country were afraid of the tyrant.
examples.zh: 國內許多人都很害怕這位專制君主。

examples.en: My boss can be a tyrant when we miss a deadline.
examples.zh: 當我們錯過期限時，我的老闆可能會變得很霸道。

examples.en: The doctor said stress had caused the stomach ulcer.
examples.zh: 醫生說壓力造成了胃潰瘍。

examples.en: He has a painful ulcer in his mouth.
examples.zh: 他的嘴裡有一個很痛的潰瘍。

examples.en: An ulcer can take weeks to heal without proper treatment.
examples.zh: 潰瘍若沒有適當的治療，可能要好幾週才會痊癒。

examples.en: Ultimately, the decision is up to you.
examples.zh: 歸根究柢，這個決定取決於你。

examples.en: He ultimately chose to study engineering instead of law.
examples.zh: 他最後選擇念工程而不是法律。

examples.en: The project ultimately saved the company a lot of money.
examples.zh: 這個專案最終為公司省下了許多錢。

examples.en: Ultraviolet light from the sun can damage your skin.
examples.zh: 來自太陽的紫外線可能會傷害你的皮膚。

examples.en: This lamp uses ultraviolet light to kill germs.
examples.zh: 這盞燈利用紫外線來殺菌。

examples.en: Some insects can see ultraviolet patterns on flowers.
examples.zh: 有些昆蟲能看見花朵上的紫外線圖案。

examples.en: The umpire called the runner out at second base.
examples.zh: 裁判判定跑者在二壘出局。

examples.en: The umpire checked the net before the tennis match began.
examples.zh: 網球比賽開始前，裁判檢查了球網。

examples.en: Both teams accepted the umpire's decision.
examples.zh: 兩隊都接受了裁判的判決。

examples.en: She umpired the softball game at school last Friday.
examples.zh: 她上週五在學校擔任了壘球賽的裁判。

examples.en: My uncle umpires baseball games on weekends.
examples.zh: 我叔叔週末擔任棒球賽的裁判。

examples.en: Who will umpire the final match of the school tournament?
examples.zh: 誰會擔任校內錦標賽決賽的裁判？

senses.zh: 不可接受的；無法容忍的；不被允許的

examples.en: Cheating on an exam is completely unacceptable.
examples.zh: 考試作弊是完全不可接受的。

examples.en: The hotel room was dirty, which was unacceptable to us.
examples.zh: 飯店房間很髒，這讓我們無法容忍。

examples.en: Loud music after midnight is unacceptable in this building.
examples.zh: 午夜後播放大聲音樂在這棟大樓是不被允許的。

examples.en: The team remained unbeaten throughout the whole season.
examples.zh: 這支球隊整季保持不敗。

examples.en: She is the unbeaten champion of our school's chess club.
examples.zh: 她是我們學校西洋棋社未嘗敗績的冠軍。

examples.en: His unbeaten record of ten wins surprised the coach.
examples.zh: 他十連勝的不敗紀錄讓教練很驚訝。

examples.en: There is a lot of uncertainty about next year's budget.
examples.zh: 對於明年的預算還有許多不確定性。

examples.en: She waited for the test results with some uncertainty.
examples.zh: 她心中帶著些許疑慮等待檢驗結果。

examples.en: Economic uncertainty makes many people save more money.
examples.zh: 經濟的不確定性讓許多人存下更多錢。

examples.en: The price of the ticket remained unchanged this year.
examples.zh: 今年的票價維持不變。

examples.en: The recipe has stayed unchanged for over fifty years.
examples.zh: 這份食譜五十多年來一直沒有改變。

examples.en: Her opinion was unchanged after she read the report.
examples.zh: 讀完報告後，她的看法沒有改變。

senses.zh: 是……的基礎；是……的根本原因

examples.en: Good teamwork underlies the success of our school band.
examples.zh: 良好的團隊合作是我們學校樂隊成功的基礎。

examples.en: Several factors underlie the rise in house prices.
examples.zh: 有幾個因素是房價上漲的根本原因。

examples.en: What underlies her fear of speaking in public?
examples.zh: 她害怕公開演講的根本原因是什麼？

senses.zh: 可以理解的；情有可原的；容易懂的

examples.en: It is understandable that you feel nervous before the interview.
examples.zh: 你在面試前感到緊張是可以理解的。

examples.en: His anger was understandable after waiting for two hours.
examples.zh: 等了兩個小時之後，他會生氣是情有可原的。

examples.en: The teacher spoke slowly so the story was understandable.
examples.zh: 老師說得很慢，所以這個故事很容易懂。

examples.en: The insurance company agreed to underwrite the new building.
examples.zh: 保險公司同意承保這棟新大樓。

examples.en: A local bank will underwrite the cost of the festival.
examples.zh: 一家本地銀行將出資資助這次慶典的費用。

examples.en: Investment banks underwrite new shares before they go on sale.
examples.zh: 投資銀行在新股票開賣前會先負責包銷。

examples.en: Her undoubted talent made her the best singer in school.
examples.zh: 她毫無疑問的才華讓她成為全校最優秀的歌手。

examples.en: The film was an undoubted success at the box office.
examples.zh: 這部電影在票房上無疑是成功的。

examples.en: He is the undoubted leader of our team.
examples.zh: 他是我們團隊公認的領袖。

examples.en: I felt uneasy when I walked home alone at night.
examples.zh: 我晚上獨自走路回家時覺得不安。

examples.en: He gave an uneasy laugh when the teacher called his name.
examples.zh: 老師叫到他的名字時，他不自在地笑了一下。

examples.en: There was an uneasy silence after the manager's announcement.
examples.zh: 經理宣布之後，出現了一陣令人不安的沉默。

examples.en: My cousin has been unemployed since the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉後，我表哥就一直失業。

examples.en: She is looking for work because she is unemployed.
examples.zh: 她因為失業而在找工作。

examples.en: Many unemployed workers attended the job fair.
examples.zh: 許多失業的工人參加了就業博覽會。

senses.zh: 不明的；身分不明的；未確認的

examples.en: Astronomers noticed an unidentified object in the sky.
examples.zh: 天文學家注意到天空中有一個不明物體。

examples.en: The package was left by an unidentified man.
examples.zh: 這個包裹是由一名身分不明的男子留下的。

examples.en: An unidentified caller left a message at the office.
examples.zh: 一名身分不明的來電者在辦公室留了訊息。

examples.en: The coach hopes to unleash the full potential of the team.
examples.zh: 教練希望釋放這支球隊的全部潛力。

examples.en: The announcement unleashed a wave of excitement among fans.
examples.zh: 這項宣布在粉絲之間引發了一股興奮的浪潮。

examples.en: Do not unleash your dog near the playground.
examples.zh: 請不要在遊樂場附近解開你的狗的牽繩。

examples.en: Workers unloaded boxes from the truck in front of the store.
examples.zh: 工人在店門口把箱子從貨車上卸下來。

examples.en: Let me unload my backpack before we go inside.
examples.zh: 進去之前，讓我先把背包卸下來。

examples.en: The ship will unload its cargo at the port tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 這艘船明天早上會在港口卸貨。

senses.zh: 取出行李物品；拆箱整理

examples.en: We unpacked our suitcases as soon as we reached the hotel.
examples.zh: 一到飯店，我們就把行李箱裡的東西拿出來整理。

examples.en: She helped her mom unpack the groceries.
examples.zh: 她幫媽媽把採買回來的東西拿出來。

examples.en: It took us a week to unpack all the boxes in the new house.
examples.zh: 我們花了一週才把新家所有的箱子拆開整理完。

examples.en: Social unrest grew as food prices kept rising.
examples.zh: 隨著食品價格持續上漲，社會動亂加劇了。

examples.en: The news report said unrest in the region has ended.
examples.zh: 新聞報導說，該地區的動亂已經結束。

examples.en: There was unrest among the workers about the new schedule.
examples.zh: 員工們對新的排班表感到不滿，現場一陣騷動。

examples.en: It was unusually cold for a day in April.
examples.zh: 以四月的天氣來說，那天異常寒冷。

examples.en: The students were unusually quiet during the class.
examples.zh: 學生們上課時異常安靜。

examples.en: She arrived unusually early at the office this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上格外早到辦公室。

senses.zh: 不想要的；多餘的；不受歡迎的

examples.en: I gave my unwanted clothes to a charity shop.
examples.zh: 我把不要的衣服捐給了慈善二手店。

examples.en: Delete unwanted emails to keep your inbox tidy.
examples.zh: 刪除多餘的電子郵件，讓你的收件匣保持整齊。

examples.en: He felt unwanted at the party because nobody talked to him.
examples.zh: 他在派對上覺得不受歡迎，因為沒有人跟他說話。

examples.en: Please keep your contact information up-to-date.
examples.zh: 請讓你的聯絡資訊保持最新。

examples.en: The museum has an up-to-date guide for visitors.
examples.zh: 博物館有一份最新的參觀導覽。

examples.en: The company uses up-to-date machines in its factory.
examples.zh: 這家公司在工廠裡使用最新式的機器。

examples.en: He had a strict upbringing in a small town.
examples.zh: 他在小鎮上受到嚴格的教養。

examples.en: Her upbringing taught her to respect older people.
examples.zh: 她的成長環境教導她要尊敬長輩。

examples.en: Parents play a major role in a child's upbringing.
examples.zh: 父母在孩子的養育過程中扮演重要的角色。

examples.en: Teachers must uphold the rules of the school.
examples.zh: 老師必須維護學校的規定。

examples.en: The court decided to uphold the earlier decision.
examples.zh: 法院決定維持先前的判決。

examples.en: We should uphold our promise to the customers.
examples.zh: 我們應該堅守對顧客的承諾。

examples.en: Uranium is a heavy metal used to produce nuclear energy.
examples.zh: 鈾是一種用來產生核能的重金屬。

examples.en: The country imports uranium for its power plants.
examples.zh: 這個國家為了發電廠而進口鈾。

examples.en: Scientists measured the amount of uranium in the rock.
examples.zh: 科學家測量了岩石中鈾的含量。

examples.en: The doctor asked for a urine sample.
examples.zh: 醫生要求採集尿液檢體。

examples.en: Healthy urine is usually pale yellow.
examples.zh: 健康的尿液通常是淡黃色的。

examples.en: A urine test can show whether you are drinking enough water.
examples.zh: 尿液檢驗可以顯示你是否喝了足夠的水。

examples.en: This matter is of the utmost importance to our company.
examples.zh: 這件事對我們公司來說極為重要。

examples.en: She handled the glass vase with the utmost care.
examples.zh: 她極為小心地拿著那個玻璃花瓶。

examples.en: Safety is our utmost concern when we travel with children.
examples.zh: 帶孩子旅行時，安全是我們最優先的考量。

examples.en: We did our utmost to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 我們盡了最大的努力準時完成專案。

examples.en: He tried his utmost to help the new student.
examples.zh: 他盡全力幫助那位新同學。

examples.en: The team worked to the utmost of its ability.
examples.zh: 團隊竭盡所能地工作。

examples.en: The firefighter made a valiant effort to save the cat.
examples.zh: 消防員英勇地努力救出那隻貓。

examples.en: Despite a valiant try, our team lost the match.
examples.zh: 儘管奮勇嘗試，我們的隊伍還是輸了比賽。

examples.en: The valiant young girl helped her neighbor in the storm.
examples.zh: 這位勇敢的小女孩在暴風雨中幫助了鄰居。

examples.en: The validity of this ticket ends on Friday.
examples.zh: 這張票的有效期限到週五截止。

examples.en: Scientists questioned the validity of the survey results.
examples.zh: 科學家質疑這項調查結果的正確性。

examples.en: Please check the validity of your passport before you travel.
examples.zh: 旅行前請確認你的護照是否仍然有效。

examples.en: Turn the valve to stop the water flow.
examples.zh: 轉動閥門來停止水流。

examples.en: The plumber replaced a broken valve under the sink.
examples.zh: 水電工更換了水槽下方壞掉的閥門。

examples.en: The heart valve controls the flow of blood.
examples.zh: 心臟瓣膜控制著血液的流動。

senses.zh: 各式各樣的；多樣的；多元的

examples.en: The menu offers a varied selection of vegetarian dishes.
examples.zh: 菜單提供各式各樣的素食料理。

examples.en: She has a varied career as a teacher and writer.
examples.zh: 她的職涯很多樣，當過老師也當過作家。

examples.en: Their interests are quite varied, from music to science.
examples.zh: 他們的興趣相當多元，從音樂到科學都有。
